candidate.blueprint_topic: Management of Care — team replanning and workload coordination
candidate.educational_objective: Use a TeamSTEPPS huddle during ongoing care when changing patient or team conditions require renewed situational awareness and possible adjustment of the care plan or workload.

options.A: Establish the initial team, roles, goals, and care plan before the work period begins.
options.B: Review completed team performance after an event to identify lessons and future improvements.
options.C: Verify that one specific message was received and understood through closed-loop communication.
options.D: Re-establish situational awareness, discuss emerging issues, and adjust the existing care plan or workload as needed.

candidate.rationale: AHRQ TeamSTEPPS defines a huddle as an ad hoc meeting used to re-establish or affirm situational awareness, reinforce the current plan, and assess whether the plan or workload needs to be adjusted as conditions change. Therefore D is correct. A describes a brief, B describes a debrief, and C describes a check-back.
candidate.source_claim_supported: A TeamSTEPPS huddle is an ad hoc replanning tool used during ongoing care to restore situational awareness, review emerging issues, and adjust an existing plan or workload when conditions change.
